name: ax
title_zh: 给 AI 编程助手装上记忆与仪表盘
tagline_zh: Claude Code 和 Codex 每次会话都失忆？ax 把每次调试、每个决策记成结构化日志，本地留存。
tagline_en: Tired of AI agents forgetting everything? ax logs every debug & decision locally, so Claude Code and Codex learn.
desc_en: the agent experience layer · observability + memory for AI coding agents (Claude Code + Codex) · local-first, typed, yours
why_zh: 不是聊天记录，是类型化的事件流。本地优先，数据归你，能按时间线回溯，也能接进自己的分析工具。
why_en: Not chat logs—typed event streams. Local-first, yours forever, timeline-queryable, and pipeable into your own tooling.
limit_zh: 只支持 Claude Code 和 Codex 两个 agent；需要 Node 18+ 且本地跑一个常驻服务。
limit_en: Only for Claude Code & Codex; needs Node 18+ and a local daemon. It logs, doesn't decide or fix bugs.
